title: A Trophy Isn’t an Audit
hook: A trophy for governance. A question about one file.
stamp: A prize says nothing about this file.

scenes.text: The agency won a governance award last week. Risk management. Compliance. Responsible innovation. Lovely photo.
panel: given by = a non-profit volunteer association

scenes.text: The prize comes from a volunteer association founded in 2019. Credible, sure. It’s also not an investigation into any particular complaint.
Fair both ways: one trophy doesn’t prove everything is fine, and one file doesn’t prove everything is broken. But a named decision-maker would settle this faster than a gala.
